## health-probes

Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-traits/health-probes.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-traits/health-probes.yaml).

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `containerName` | string |  | `main` | Name of the container the probes are attached to. Defaults to 'main'. |
| `liveness` | object |  | `{}` | Restarts the container when it stops being healthy. |
| `liveness.enabled` | boolean |  | `false` | Enabled |
| `liveness.failureThreshold` | integer |  | `3` | Failure threshold Range 1... |
| `liveness.handler` | any |  |  |  |
| `liveness.initialDelaySeconds` | integer |  | `0` | Seconds to wait after the container starts before the first probe. Range 0... |
| `liveness.periodSeconds` | integer |  | `10` | Period seconds Range 1... |
| `liveness.timeoutSeconds` | integer |  | `1` | Timeout seconds Range 1... |
| `readiness` | object |  | `{}` | Removes the pod from service endpoints while it is not ready to receive traffic. |
| `readiness.enabled` | boolean |  | `false` | Enabled |
| `readiness.failureThreshold` | integer |  | `3` | Failure threshold Range 1... |
| `readiness.handler` | any |  |  |  |
| `readiness.initialDelaySeconds` | integer |  | `0` | Seconds to wait after the container starts before the first probe. Range 0... |
| `readiness.periodSeconds` | integer |  | `10` | Period seconds Range 1... |
| `readiness.successThreshold` | integer |  | `1` | Consecutive successes before the pod is considered ready. Range 1... |
| `readiness.timeoutSeconds` | integer |  | `1` | Timeout seconds Range 1... |
| `startup` | object |  | `{}` | Holds off the liveness and readiness probes until the container has finished starting. |
| `startup.enabled` | boolean |  | `false` | Enabled |
| `startup.failureThreshold` | integer |  | `30` | Failure threshold Range 1... |
| `startup.handler` | any |  |  |  |
| `startup.initialDelaySeconds` | integer |  | `0` | Seconds to wait after the container starts before the first probe. Range 0... |
| `startup.periodSeconds` | integer |  | `10` | Period seconds Range 1... |
| `startup.timeoutSeconds` | integer |  | `1` | Timeout seconds Range 1... |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean |  | `true` | Master switch for this environment. When disabled, none of the probes are configured here. |

## horizontal-pod-autoscaler

Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-traits/hpa.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-traits/hpa.yaml).

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `replicas` | object |  | `{}` | Replicas |
| `replicas.max` | integer | yes | `10` | Maximum Range 1... |
| `replicas.min` | integer | yes | `1` | Minimum Range 1... |
| `targetUtilization` | object |  | `{}` | Target utilization levels the autoscaler maintains by adding or removing replicas. |
| `targetUtilization.cpu` | integer |  | `80` | Average CPU across pods, as a percentage of the pod's CPU request. Range 1..100. |
| `targetUtilization.memory` | integer |  |  | Average memory across pods, as a percentage of the pod's memory request. Optional; when unset, memory is not used for scaling. Range 1..100. |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean |  | `true` | Controls whether autoscaling is active in this environment. When disabled, no HorizontalPodAutoscaler is created. |
| `maxReplicas` | integer |  |  | Optional per-environment override for the upper replica bound. Range 1... |
| `minReplicas` | integer |  |  | Optional per-environment override for the lower replica bound. Range 1... |

## keda-scaler

Event-driven autoscaling with KEDA (cron, cpu, memory, prometheus, kafka, ... triggers), including scale to zero. Needs a data plane that runs addon keda. Do not combine with horizontal-pod-autoscaler. Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/platform/cluster-traits/keda-scaler.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/platform/cluster-traits/keda-scaler.yaml). Needs data-plane addons: keda.

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cooldownPeriod` | integer |  | `300` | Wait after the last active trigger before scaling to minReplicas 0 (only used with minReplicas 0). Range 0... |
| `maxReplicas` | integer |  | `5` | Maximum replicas Range 1... |
| `minReplicas` | integer |  | `1` | 0 scales the component to zero while no trigger is active (requests to it fail until KEDA scales it up: there is no HTTP activator). Range 0... |
| `pollingInterval` | integer |  | `30` | How often KEDA checks each trigger. Range 5... |
| `triggers` | object[] | yes |  | KEDA scalers (https://keda.sh/docs/latest/scalers/), e.g. {type: cpu, metricType: Utilization, metadata: {value: "80"}} or {type: cron, metadata: {timezone: Europe/Tallinn, start: "0 8 * * 1-5", end: "0 18 * * 1-5", desiredReplicas: "3"}}. Range 1..10 items. |
| `triggers[].authenticationRef` | object |  |  | A TriggerAuthentication in the component's namespace (ClusterTriggerAuthentication is not offered to tenants). |
| `triggers[].authenticationRef.name` | string | yes |  | Range 1.. chars. |
| `triggers[].metadata` | map[string]string | yes |  |  |
| `triggers[].metricType` | string |  |  | One of `AverageValue`, `Value`, `Utilization`. |
| `triggers[].name` | string |  |  |  |
| `triggers[].type` | string | yes |  | Range 1.. chars. |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean |  | `true` | When disabled, no ScaledObject is created and the component type's replicas apply again. |
| `maxReplicas` | integer |  |  | Optional per-environment override for the upper replica bound. Range 1... |
| `minReplicas` | integer |  |  | Optional per-environment override for the lower replica bound. Range 0... |

## observability-alert-rule

Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-traits/observability-alert-rule.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-traits/observability-alert-rule.yaml).

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | object | yes |  |  |
| `condition.interval` | string |  | `1m` | The frequency at which the alert rule is evaluated (e.g. 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m). |
| `condition.operator` | string |  | `gt` | The comparison operator used to evaluate the condition against the threshold (gt: greater than, lt: less than, gte: greater than or equal, lte: less than or equal, eq: equal). One of `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`, `eq`. |
| `condition.threshold` | integer |  | `10` | The numeric threshold value used with the operator to determine when the alert triggers. |
| `condition.window` | string |  | `5m` | The time window over which data is aggregated before evaluating the alert condition (e.g. 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h). |
| `description` | string | yes |  | A human-readable description of what this alert rule monitors and when it triggers. |
| `severity` | string |  | `warning` | The severity level of alerts triggered by this rule. Determines alert priority and notification urgency. One of `info`, `warning`, `critical`. |
| `source` | object | yes |  |  |
| `source.metric` | string |  | `""` | The predefined metric to monitor for metric-based alerts. Must be one of: cpu_usage, memory_usage. Required when source type is 'metric'. |
| `source.query` | string |  | `""` | The query expression for log-based alerts. Required when source type is 'log'. |
| `source.type` | string | yes |  | The data source type for the alert rule. One of `log`, `metric`, `budget`. |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `actions` | object |  |  |  |
| `actions.incident` | object |  |  |  |
| `actions.incident.enabled` | boolean |  | `false` | Enables incident creation when this alert fires. When enabled, a corresponding incident will be created in the incident management system. |
| `actions.incident.triggerAiCostAnalysis` | boolean |  | `false` | Enables AI-powered cost analysis when an incident is created for a budget alert. Provides automated cost breakdown and optimization recommendations. Requires incident.enabled to also be true and is only valid for budget source type. |
| `actions.incident.triggerAiRca` | boolean |  | `false` | Enables AI-powered root cause analysis when an incident is created. When enabled, provides automated reports of root causes for alert conditions. Requires incident.enabled to also be true. |
| `actions.notifications` | object |  |  |  |
| `actions.notifications.channels` | string[] |  | `[]` | The notification channel identifiers where alerts should be delivered. Configured per environment by platform engineers. If not provided, defaults to the environment's default notification channel. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | `true` | Controls whether this alert rule is active. When disabled, the rule will not trigger alerts. |

## persistent-volume-claim

Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-traits/pvc.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-traits/pvc.yaml).

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accessMode` | string |  | `ReadWriteOnce` | Access mode One of `ReadWriteOnce`, `ReadOnlyMany`, `ReadWriteMany`, `ReadWriteOncePod`. |
| `containerName` | string |  | `main` | Name of the container the volume is mounted into. Defaults to 'main'. |
| `mountPath` | string | yes |  | Absolute path inside the container where the volume is mounted (e.g. /data). |
| `readOnly` | boolean |  | `false` | Mounts the volume as read-only in the container. |
| `subPath` | string |  |  | Optional path within the volume to mount instead of its root. |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean |  | `true` | Controls whether persistent storage is provisioned in this environment. When disabled, no PersistentVolumeClaim is created and the volume is not mounted. |
| `size` | string |  | `1Gi` | Requested storage capacity for the volume (e.g. 1Gi, 10Gi). |
| `storageClass` | string |  |  | Optional storage class for the volume. When unset, the cluster's default storage class is used. |

## resilience

Topology spread, PodDisruptionBudget, graceful shutdown and priority per environment. Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/platform/cluster-traits/resilience.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/platform/cluster-traits/resilience.yaml).

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nodePool` | string |  | `""` | Opt-in dedicated node pool (nodes labelled platform.koorikla.io/node-pool=<value>). |
| `preStopSleepSeconds` | integer |  | `5` | Seconds a terminating pod keeps serving while endpoints and the gateway drop it. Range 0... |
| `replicas` | integer |  | `1` | The component type's replicas (bound by the component type, not set here). Range 0... |
| `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` | integer |  | `30` | Range 1... |
| `zoneSpread` | string |  | `ScheduleAnyway` | DoNotSchedule keeps replicas in different zones even if that leaves a pod Pending. Only on data planes whose nodes carry topology.kubernetes.io/zone: nodes without the label are not eligible at all. One of `ScheduleAnyway`, `DoNotSchedule`. |
